overview: When an agent acts on its own, you need to see what it did and why. We add logging to your agent so each run records the request, the steps taken, the tools used and the result, then send those records to a sheet or log tool. We add alerts for failures and strange behavior, and a simple view your team can read without technical help.

faq: In your own accounts, such as a Google Sheet, database or log tool you choose. We do not keep copies, and you decide how long records are retained.
Do logs contain private customer data?
They can, so we mask or leave out sensitive fields you name, such as emails or card details. Tell us what must never appear, and we test that it stays out.
Can I see why the agent made a choice?
You can see the information it received, the steps it took and the tools it used. That usually explains the choice, though a model's inner reasoning is never fully visible.
Will monitoring slow the agent down?
Very little. Logging happens alongside the work. If a log tool is down, the agent carries on and queues the records so nothing is silently lost.
